verdict.rationale: Mistral ships a dedicated 'Known limitations' page and an error glossary in its docs (mistral-docs-14, mistral-supp-known-limitations), which is genuine first-party acknowledgment of some failure modes (e.g., context-window overflow errors). However, this page appears narrowly technical/API-focused rather than covering model behavioral jagged edges (hallucination tendencies, reasoning weaknesses, benchmark gaps, OCR/multilingual issues) that independent testers (mistral-comm-6, mistral-comm-9, mistral-comm-14/15/16) surfaced but which are not reflected in vendor docs. Missing for 10: explicit vendor documentation of model-quality weaknesses (reasoning, OCR accuracy, multilingual gaps), acknowledgment of benchmark underperformance, discussion of hallucination or bias risks in the model cards.
